preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two lines: the shuffled string and the remembered substring.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[0]) and all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: Both lines contain only digits. The first line is the shuffled string, the second is the remembered substring.
The length of the shuffled string does not exceed 1,000,000 digits.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == min([candidate for candidate in generate_valid_candidates(stdin) if is_valid_candidate(candidate, stdin)])
postconditions.description: The output is the smallest valid integer `n` such that when `n` is written as a string and concatenated with its digit count `k`, the resulting string can be shuffled to match the input string, and the remembered substring appears in `n`.
The output `n` has no leading zeros unless it is exactly '0'.
The remembered substring appears as a contiguous subsequence in the output `n`.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout) == len([c for c in stdout if c.isdigit()])
postconditions.description: The output `n` consists only of digits.
